catalogue_requests.reason: cap.motion.home.v1 is the only catalogue home class, but its optional axes and speed_scale inputs have no implementation in the upstream: the clone's home command is a fixed single-axis 'ho' move with no speed argument. Using the class would expose controls the device cannot honor and would fail the class's numeric-input limits; the extension has no input.
catalogue_requests.summary: Home the single rotation axis with the upstream 'ho' move.

notes:
Passed on the fake backend by python3 -m mhs.driver check (evidence contract_checked, never an MHS-Device level). Model-authored and unreviewed; no hardware was attached or run. The loader refuses a model-written hardware backend at R2 and R3, not at this package's R1, so a human must review it before hardware use. DEVIATION FROM THE CARD: the card's SerialDriver helper and its cap.device.configure.v1 / cap.sensing.read.v1 hints do not express the interface; the upstream builds every command from an address digit, a two-letter instruction and an optional hexadecimal data field (elliptec/rotation.py:28-76), so this is a direct Driver over elliptec.rotation:Motor with native.py. cap.device.configure.v1 serves the two writable state fields; reads are resource state reads, and cap.sensing.read.v1's resource kinds do not include motion.axis. The position bound is operator_required: the clone states no numeric travel range; the motor reports Range and Pulse/Rev at connect (elliptec/rotation.py:22-24). site-limits.example.json's 0..360 deg is an example, not a device fact. The step-size 1..359 deg bound is the upstream GUI's control range (td_gui.py:109-110), not a datasheet. The home action is the extension x-cap.cdbaird.home.v1 because cap.motion.home.v1's optional axes and speed_scale have no upstream implementation (home is a fixed single-axis 'ho' move). The fake is an in-memory state machine, not a recording: its Range 360, Pulse/Rev 262144, serial number, start position 90 deg and step size 45 deg are placeholders, not facts; it does not model move time, mechanical errors or the connect-time 'in' exchange (the info dict is canned). The upstream hex_to_deg is unusable (it reads an undefined val, elliptec/rotation.py:83-86); the driver converts counts with the same integer factor deg_to_hex uses (counts_per_rev // range). No independent hardware e-stop is cited: the device is R1 and the clone has no hardware stop text; the @estop isolates the module with set_('isolate', '01') (main.py:56-58), and the status_code read reports 5 (Module Isolated). check-report.json is regenerated by every gate run and is not part of the package; gate.digest is the digest line the last check printed.
